component.name: Autodesk Fusion
component.summary: Run Autodesk Fusion on Linux via Wine

description.p: Unofficial Flatpak packaging that runs Autodesk Fusion on Linux. The package bundles GE-Proton (Wine), winetricks, p7zip and cabextract; on first launch it creates a dedicated Wine prefix in the app's data directory, installs Fusion from Autodesk's official installer, and applies the community-documented compatibility fixes. Fusion itself is downloaded from Autodesk at first run and is not redistributed with this package.
